pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions on the upper dorsal ridge transitioning to smaller, more fragmented sub-rectangular regions on the lower posterior flank. Edges show soft pixel gradients, likely due to image resolution, rather than sharp geometric transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of light pelage. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness is highest in the mid-dorsal region and narrows as the network density increases toward the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour is visible along the cervical-dorsal transition, representing the mane silhouette against the background.
